title: Strongest true-positive churn signal found — self-reported triple drift
quote:
plan-045: make REQ-CLI-006 self-consistent and actually executed

Third drift of one REQ inside one plan: grep gave 25, the spec asserted 24, and retrospective-report was unenumerated. It survived a 33/33 FULL-tier sweep because the REQ's own Verification line was prose shaped like a command -- nothing ran it.
